title: Morph shapes
description: One thin gold outline changes shape at every step (GSAP MorphSVG): play button, slide, browser window, cube or circle, and the label beside it changes with it. On a slide each click is one step.

props.stages: required, 2-5 of {shape: play | slide | browser | cube | circle, label, text}

stages.label: Video
stages.text: Motion graphics on your own video.

stages.label: Slides
stages.text: The same motion on a deck you present.

stages.label: Website
stages.text: And on a page that moves as you scroll.
